mapper.select: SELECT id, name, category, sort_order, is_active, create_time, update_time FROM yy_specialty_dict WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY category, sort_order
SELECT id, name, category, sort_order, is_active, create_time, update_time FROM yy_specialty_dict WHERE category = #{category} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT id, name, category, sort_order, is_active, create_time, update_time FROM yy_specialty_dict WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.category, s.sort_order, s.is_active, s.create_time, s.update_time FROM yy_specialty_dict s INNER JOIN yy_doctor_specialty ds ON s.id = ds.specialty_id WHERE ds.doc_id = #{docId} AND s.is_active = 1 ORDER BY s.sort_order
